_doc: The undercity (Systems/Undercity.cs). Each level opens when the town reaches its charter tier and adds its site to the bounty board, under the town (distance 0). Every open, uncleared level stirs each day: its stir, plus stirPerFaction for each active secret faction, plus stirPerHundred per 100 residents; a patrol (patrolCost gold a day) cuts it by patrolCut. At warnAt the town hears it; at riseAt something comes up: riseDead townsfolk lost (one fewer with a patrol), riseMandate, riseTension, and stir falls to riseAfter. Clearing a level quiets it for refillDays (then it fills again at riseAfter stir), gives clearedMandate and heat to secret factions (clearedHeat); then the dark below fills again. The stand-in mayor patrols a level from standInAt stir when the treasury holds standInGold.

levels.name: the Old Cellars
levels.text: Under the old town's houses run cellars older than the houses: smugglers' holes, forgotten wine vaults and rooms nobody remembers bricking up.
levels.rise: Things come up through the cellar floors in the night: rats in their hundreds, and something bigger behind them.

encounters.text: giant rats boiling out of a broken barrel
a rotten floor over a deeper cellar
something squeezing between the walls
a smuggler's stash behind a loose brick

boss.text: the rat-mother's nest, a seething heap of fur

levels.name: the Sewers
levels.text: The town's new sewers run into old brick tunnels nobody dug. Night-soil men say the tunnels go further every year.
levels.rise: The sewer grates lift in the night. What climbs out drags a watchman back down with it.

encounters.text: centipedes as long as a man in the brickwork
the tunnel floods with a black, stinking tide
a grey slick on the walkway that moves
something swimming under the sludge
a night-soil man who knows the old tunnels

boss.text: the otyugh that has been eating the town's refuse for years

levels.name: the Catacombs
levels.text: Below the sewers the masons broke into catacombs: niche on niche of the dead of a town that stood here before this one.
levels.rise: The dead of the old town walk up out of the catacombs and through the streets until dawn.

encounters.text: skeletons stepping out of their niches
a collapsing ossuary stair
ghouls at their feast
cold breath in the dark
a sealed tomb with a riddle on its door

boss.text: a wight in the rusted crown of a forgotten lord

levels.name: the Drowned Vaults
levels.text: Deeper still lie vaults of a treasury from before the town: flooded halls, sealed strongrooms and the things that came to guard them.
levels.rise: Shapes of living shadow rise through the cellars of the market, and three families do not wake.

encounters.text: gargoyles on the vault arches
a strongroom door rigged with a falling block
a strongbox that bites
something old in the flooded halls
coin chests in a sealed strongroom

boss.text: the vault's warden, a pale thing that has not seen the sun in an age

levels.name: the Deep Ways
levels.text: At the bottom of the vaults a stair runs on down, into the dark between the roots of the world.
levels.rise: Something vast stirs under the city. Streets crack, a well fills with black water and the gibbering is heard from the cellars of a whole ward.

encounters.text: gricks folded among the stalactites
a chasm with a rope bridge older than the town
a gibbering mouth of many mouths
the dark looking back
a dead explorer's pack

boss.text: a cloaker hanging over the last stair
